title: Backstitch: Restoring Request Causality Across a Production Microservice Fleet
summary: A major video platform runs on thousands of microservices, each request propagating a context so downstream work can be traced and governed. At handoffs outside instrumented paths, e.g., custom queues and callbacks, the payload continues but the context does not, and the request still succeeds under existing tests.
